mapper.insert: insert into init_rtks_role (select * from rtks_role where rtks_role.resource_id = #{resourceId})

insert into init_rtks_role (`resource_id`, `name`, `description`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `level_id`, `category`, `task_ids`, `knowledge_id_weights`, `knowledge_ids`, `skill_id_weights`, `skill_ids`, `ability_ids`, `skill_courses`, `knowledge_courses`, `knowledge_weight`, `skill_missions`) values (#{role.resourceId}, #{role.name}, #{role.description}, now(), now(), #{role.levelId}, '', #{role.taskIds}, #{role.knowledgeIdWeights}, #{role.knowledgeIds}, #{role.skillIdWeight}, #{role.skillIds}, #{role.abilityIds}, #{role.skillCourses}, #{role.knowledgeCourses}, #{role.knowledgeWeight}, #{role.skillMissions})

insert into init_rtks_role_skill_relation (role_id, skill_id, weight, create_time, update_time) values
(#{relation.roleId}, #{relation.skillId}, #{relation.weight}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select `name` from init_rtks_level order by id desc limit 1
